notes: PASS on all controller gates: worker/engine recovery, dedupe, approval wait/resume, cancellation, retry, movement, UNKNOWN_RECONCILE, inspect/replay and no duplicate external effects.
Simulated effects A and B remained exactly once.
Replay re-executed internal task/finalization events, so the fixture validates pre-replay finalize-once plus post-replay external-effect singleton safety rather than zero internal re-execution.
Internal candidate network, no host ports, zero production credentials and zero production authority.
Provider-truth reconciliation protected the ambiguous effect.
External effects remained singleton even after operator replay.
Hatchet Lite is simple to package but depends on PostgreSQL for the tested self-host shape.
Official docs note engine migrations at startup and warn not to let multiple engines apply migrations concurrently.
Recovery/reassignment waits made this benchmark materially slower than Restate and Temporal.
Full semantic controller checks passed and raw Docker resource samples were retained.
Resource parser defects were repaired from immutable raw samples; corrected receipt records wall/CPU/RAM/network/storage without changing semantic evidence.
Hatchet self-host state is PostgreSQL-backed; database backup/restore is the primary state rollback surface.
Official embedded/self-host docs describe migration control and single-migrator requirements: https://docs.hatchet.run/v1/embedded and https://docs.hatchet.run/v1/running-locally
A restore drill is still required before any production authority.

security_findings: No production credentials or production authority were used.
LAB token stayed inside the isolated benchmark and was removed during teardown.
Production keyset/TLS hardening was not part of this benchmark.
operations_findings: Corrected resource capture: wall 284.583 s; aggregate peak CPU 2.76%; aggregate peak RAM 574.01 MiB; observed network 17.061 MiB; storage delta 28.389 MiB.
Operator replay can re-run internal tasks, reinforcing the need for effect-level idempotency even though no external duplicate occurred.
